intro.heading: Comprehensive Care for Patients Worldwide
text: For patients travelling from other countries for healthcare, planning treatment and managing a stay away from home can be challenging. Cambridge Hospital provides a range of healthcare services alongside dedicated support for international patients, including care planning, coordination and practical support throughout their stay.

From initial assessment and personalised treatment planning through medical care, rehabilitation and follow-up, our teams work closely with patients and their families to coordinate their care, ensure a smooth experience and help them navigate each stage of their treatment journey.
